description: 'Declare none or declare all, and say which' -- the released rule on bitemporal-assertion.v1 /value. A declared sibling revokes the subtree's opacity, after which every member must be declared; a declaration-only pointer deliberately is not one, so this shape would raise UndeclaredPathError at HASH time, far from the schema that caused it. Diagnosed at derivation instead, naming both annotations.
expected_message_contains: both declares members ["/value/note"] and carries x-datacompany-hash-declaration-only at ["/value/tags"]
